description: Pauses, continues or steps the debugged game. A step waits for the game to stop again and answers with the stack where it ended up; one that has not stopped the game again within ten seconds answers heldAgain false and no stack. A game the editor plays is moved through the editor's debug adapter, which cannot pause or step out: it answers a pause by reporting the game stopped and leaving it running, and implements no stepOut, so hold such a game with a breakpoint and step over or into from there. A game this server started itself has its keeper as its debugger, which does both: pause breaks into the game wherever it is, a script spinning in a loop included, which is how a game hung on its first frame is asked where it is. For such a game a step that ends in gdharness's runtime addon, as one past a function's last line does when the addon's _process runs next, is stepped on to the game's own script as a pause is; and since the engine reports every stop the same way, a step that stops on a line holding a breakpoint says onBreakpoint under held, whether the step ended there or ran into it. Operations: pause: stop a game this server started where it is, answering with the stack. The game takes it between frames, and in a script every 2048 lines it runs, so a loop that sleeps between few lines can take seconds; the call waits thirty, and past that answers paused false with the request still standing. Stopped between frames, where no script runs, the game is stepped on to the next line of script it runs, and stopped in gdharness's runtime addon, an autoload whose _process runs first in every frame, on to the next line of the game's own script, for up to five seconds; one whose stack is still the addon's after them says so in a note; continue: resume after a breakpoint; step_over: run the current line; step_into: run the current line, stopping inside whatever it calls; step_out: run to the end of the current function and stop in its caller; a game this server started only.
name: debug_control
title: Step the debugger
